facets.label: Issue types

groups.name: Food fraud and authenticity
groups.definition: Issues concerning product identity, composition, substitution, dilution, or fraudulent presentation.

entries.name: Adulteration
entries.definition: A substance, process, or product condition is reported as compromising the food.

entries.name: Substitution

entries.name: Dilution
